collection.does_not: fixture setup, test call, final execution key, eligibility, cache hit, or skip
collection.establishes: locator-first collection seed and stable TestLocatorKey before any runtime trace

fixture_timing.does_not: pre-call TestExecutionKeyV2 or an authoritative fixture-instance key at collection

di.does_not: fabricate missing lookup, store, provider, or issuer authority

runtime_trace.does_not: re-enter the test body or publish from incomplete, overflowed, or exceptional traces

xdist_publication.establishes: workers return bounded public intents; only the controller may flush accepted publication
